description: This Java source file defines the MailMessageSender class, which implements the MessageSender interface to send email messages using JavaMail API within the OpenMRS framework. It handles message creation, including support for attachments, and manages the JavaMail session configuration.

classes.name: MailMessageSender
classes.description: A class responsible for sending email messages using JavaMail, implementing the MessageSender interface in the OpenMRS framework. Supports direct message sending, message creation with attachments, and session management.

methods.name: MailMessageSender
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MailMessageSender with a specific JavaMail session.

methods.name: setMailSession
methods.description: Sets the JavaMail session used for sending emails.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an email message; converts Message to MimeMessage and transmits via JavaMail.

methods.name: createMimeMessage
methods.description: Creates a MimeMessage object from a Message, setting recipients, sender, subject, and content, including attachment handling.

methods.name: createMultipart
methods.description: Creates a MimeMultipart object for messages with attachments, combining text content and attachment parts.
